**What the customer wants:** 
The customer wants the correct power adapter for their replacement hub (order LM-46855) after receiving a US-style plug that does not fit their outlets. They also want advice on how to avoid similar support issues in the future and a personalized, non-templated written apology.

**What has been done so far:** 
The agent dispatched the correct power adapter (tracking LMT-5521-014-IN) and added a detailed note to the customer's account so they will not have to repeat their history on future contacts.

**What happens next:** 
The agent will send a personal written apology to the customer via email, and the customer awaits delivery of the replacement adapter.
